title: Conditioning and interpolation error bounds for second-order Stiefel retractions with closed-form inverses
summary: Retractions provide a computationally efficient alternative to the Riemannian exponential and logarithm maps for practical data-processing tasks on manifolds. In particular, second-order retractions with closed-form inverse are well-suited for interpolation problems on manifolds. On the Stiefel manifold of orthogonal frames, there are only two retractions of this type: the Cayley retraction, which is second-order accurate under the canonical metric, and the recently proposed polar-light retraction, which is second-order accurate under the Euclidean metric.
